## Frequently Asked Questions

## Do I need any prior coding or tech experience to join a bootcamp?

No, our bootcamps are designed for beginners! We teach you everything from the ground up, ensuring you develop the skills you need to succeed, even if you're new to tech.

## How do the live classes work?

We offer live classes twice a week—once in the morning and once in the evening, so you can choose the time that suits you. If you miss a session, don’t worry—recordings are available for you to catch up at your convenience.

## What kind of job support does Zaio offer?

We offer guaranteed job placement assistance. This includes resume building, interview coaching, mock interviews, and direct connections to hiring partners to help you secure your first tech job.

## How flexible are the payment options?

We offer multiple payment options to fit your budget. You can pay upfront, in installments, or finance your education through partners like Manati and Capitec. This allows you to focus on learning while paying over time.

## What happens if I fall behind in the course?

Don’t worry! Our 24/7 tutor support is here to help. You can reach out any time for assistance, and we’ll work with you to ensure you stay on track. Plus, you can catch up by watching recorded class sessions.

## What career outcomes can I expect after completing the bootcamp?

Zaio graduates have gone on to secure roles as web developers, data scientists, and junior software engineers. Our job placement support helps you land interviews, and our alumni network provides additional support as you navigate your job search.

## Can I study while working full-time?

Yes! Our flexible learning options, including live classes held at different times and recorded sessions, allow you to study while balancing a full-time job or other commitments.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What is the price of the bootcamp and are there any payment plans?

The fees are R29,950 and we have 3 payment options-

- Upfront payment (full payment of R29,950)
- 2 part payment plan (R14,975 + R14,975)
- Financing through our third party called Manati student funding

## What is the duration of the Bootcamp?

The bootcamp runs over period of 6 months, broken down into weekly and daily tasks for you to complete.

## Are there any exams or tests in the bootcamp?

There are no exams or tests, however the bootcamp is project based and will require you to complete certain tasks.

## What happens if I need support?

We believe the best method of support is community based, once you start the bootcamp, you will be enrolled in our discord community channel where you will gain direct access to the tutors and your fellow classmates. You will be able to interact and ask questions with real time answers.

## I have never coded before, will I cope?

Our philosophy is that anyone can code as long as you are able to decide to wear something warm on a cold day. You do not require any previous coding experience as the course is tailored to students with varying degrees of experience.

## What happens should I fail any of the assignments or fail the bootcamp? Will I have to do another bootcamp?

We will provide you with feedback throughout the bootcamp and you will have the opportunity to book one on one sessions with the head tutor should you feel you are struggling and falling behind. We will provide you with all the tools necessary to ensure you are set up for success.

## How long will I have access to the recorded material once the bootcamp ends?

Yes you will have access to all material for the next 12 months.

## What happens if I fail the interview and do not get the job?

Due to the competitive nature of hiring for roles, we do not guarantee that you will be placed in a role, as there are many mitigating circumstances. What we will do is provide you with the support and skills to be best prepared for the interview.

## What is the price of the bootcamp and are there any payment plans?
The fees are R29,950 and we have 3 payment options-

- Upfront payment (full payment of R29,950)
- 2 part payment plan (R14,975 + R14,975)
- Financing through our third party called Manati student funding
## What is the duration of the Bootcamp?
The bootcamp runs over period of 6 months, broken down into weekly and daily tasks for you to complete.
## Are there any exams or tests in the bootcamp?
There are no exams or tests, however the bootcamp is project based and will require you to complete certain tasks.
## What happens if I need support?

We believe the best method of support is community based, once you start the bootcamp, you will be enrolled in our discord community channel where you will gain direct access to the tutors and your fellow classmates. You will be able to interact and ask questions with real time answers.
## I have never coded before, will I cope?

Our philosophy is that anyone can code as long as you are able to decide to wear something warm on a cold day. You do not require any previous coding experience as the course is tailored to students with varying degrees of experience.
## What happens should I fail any of the assignments or fail the bootcamp? Will I have to do another bootcamp?

We will provide you with feedback throughout the bootcamp and you will have the opportunity to book one on one sessions with the head tutor should you feel you are struggling and falling behind. We will provide you with all the tools necessary to ensure you are set up for success.
## How long will I have access to the recorded material once the bootcamp ends?
Yes you will have access to all material for the next 12 months.
## What happens if I fail the interview and do not get the job?

Due to the competitive nature of hiring for roles, we do not guarantee that you will be placed in a role, as there are many mitigating circumstances. What we will do is provide you with the support and skills to be best prepared for the interview.
## Will I receive a certificate at the end of the bootcamp?
Yes you will receive a certificate which is recognized internationally, additionally, you will be invited to attend a virtual graduation ceremony.
